PR1a — Profile + display name + session-carry (purses-wew) (#245)

* spec: UI/experience cluster design (epics A-D, sequencing, owner decisions)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* spec: fold adversarial spec-review findings (RoleBadge, count-grid, session-carry, CI placement, a11y prereqs)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* plan: PR1a profile + display name + session-carry (purses-wew)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* a11y(input): associate label with control via id (purses-1qor)

* feat(profile): name-only update with trim/max/clear (purses-wew)

* feat(auth): carry + refresh display name through the session (purses-wew)

* test(auth): restore no-op + no-user branch coverage (review fix)

* feat(profile): editable display-name form (purses-wew)

* feat(profile): profile page + header entry point (purses-wew)

* test(e2e): display-name reflects in header (purses-wew)

profile.spec.ts: authenticate via the shared storageState, edit the
labelled "Display name" on /profile, Save, and assert the banner shows
the new (unique, uuid-suffixed) name with no reload. Runs on all three
viewport projects.

purses-asz (UI-login→protected-page) was already covered by
e2e/auth-navigation.spec.ts, so no login-protected.spec.ts is added.
purses-y1o's shared ui.ts is consumed by auth.spec.ts and
auth-navigation.spec.ts.

Cross-spec safe: every other spec keys off email/the session API, never
the display name; the new spec asserts on a freshly-set unique name.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(profile): empty-patch no-op + contract reconcile, announce save failure, session/clear correctness (review folds)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: name-only PATCH /api/users/me + display-name session-carry (sync-docs)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(screenshots): capture /profile surface (purses-wew)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
